NDIS support in Parramatta

NDIS Provider in Parramatta

Ahsan Care is a registered NDIS provider supporting participants across Parramatta and Western Sydney. We match you with screened support workers who fit your routine, your language and your culture, so the help feels right from the first visit.

We usually reply within one business day. Your details are only used to arrange your support.

Local support

Disability support that fits life in Parramatta

Parramatta and the wider Western Sydney area are among the most culturally diverse parts of Australia. Families here often want a provider who understands language, faith and everyday routines, not just a service that turns up and ticks a box.

Our support workers come to you at home and out in the community, and we take the time to match the right person to your needs. Because we are a registered NDIS provider, every worker is screened and works to the NDIS Code of Conduct, so you can feel confident about who is walking through your door.

We work as a service-area provider across Parramatta. There is no local shopfront to visit; instead, support comes to you, arranged around the days and times that suit your household.

NDIS services we provide in Parramatta

Practical, everyday support delivered by workers who get to know you. Each service links to the full details, including what is and is not included.

Personal care and daily living in Parramatta

Respectful help with showering, dressing, grooming and medication prompts, delivered the way you prefer. Ask for a same-gender or same-language worker and we will do our best to arrange it.

More about personal care and daily living

Household tasks in Parramatta

A hand with cleaning, laundry, meal preparation and keeping the home running, so your space stays comfortable, safe and easy to move around.

More about help with household tasks

Community participation in Parramatta

Support to get out and about, from appointments and shopping to social groups, study and local activities right across Parramatta and Western Sydney.

More about community participation

Nursing care in Parramatta

Clinical support from qualified nurses for medication management, wound care and more complex health needs, coordinated with your plan and your GP.

More about NDIS nursing care
The right worker for you

Support workers who understand you

We match by language, gender, culture and daily routine. If it matters to you that your worker speaks Arabic, Urdu, Hindi or another language, understands prayer times, or knows how a halal kitchen runs, tell us and we will work to match it. This is the heart of our culturally responsive and Muslim NDIS support.

From home to the wider community

Good support is about more than the home. We help participants stay connected to the places and people that matter, whether that is getting to medical appointments, doing the weekly shop, joining a class or simply spending time somewhere familiar.

Workers travel with you, build confidence at a pace that feels comfortable, and keep families in the loop. Over time the aim is more independence and a fuller week, on your terms.

Good to know

NDIS questions from Parramatta families

Yes. Ahsan Care is a registered NDIS provider, number 4-L7JCZ6S. That means our support workers are screened, we follow the NDIS Code of Conduct, and we can support both plan-managed and self-managed participants. You can check any provider on the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission website.

We support Parramatta and many nearby Western Sydney suburbs on a service-area basis, which means our workers travel to you at home and in the community. Coverage for a specific street or time depends on worker availability, so the quickest way to confirm is to send an enquiry and we will let you know.

Wherever we can, yes. We match by language, gender, culture and routine, and this is one of the main reasons families choose us. Tell us your preferences when you enquire and we will be honest about what we can arrange in your area.

We charge in line with the current NDIS Pricing Arrangements, with fixed pricing and no call-out fee. If your supports are funded in your plan, they are usually claimed against it. We are happy to walk you through this and give you a free, clear quote before anything starts.

Send the enquiry form or call 0416 623 317. We will arrange a free consultation to understand your goals, then match you with a support worker. There is no obligation and no cost to have that first conversation.
